overview:
Kata is a west-coast beach area in Mueang Phuket district, south of Karon and north of Nai Harn. Our catalogue lists three condominium projects here, all still in pre-sale or under construction, with developers including Origin Property and Rhom Bho Property.
The portals we reviewed disagree on whether some of these projects belong to Kata or to neighbouring Karon (Kata and Karon share a subdistrict), so confirm the exact address with us before you rely on the location.
